claim: Locally Uncensored is a free, open-source all-in-one local AI studio desktop app (Windows and Linux, macOS/Android in beta): chat, image generation, video generation and a coding agent in one window, everything on the user's own machine with no Docker, no terminal and no config files. Auto-detects or installs a local engine (Ollama / LM Studio / its own llama.cpp-based engine) and ComfyUI for media; model manager marks which models fit the hardware.
